joins: plans.service_area_id = service_area_counties.service_area_id AND plans.issuer_id = service_area_counties.issuer_id AND plans.plan_year = service_area_counties.plan_year
crosswalk.prior_plan_id = plans.standard_component_id AND crosswalk.plan_year - 1 = plans.plan_year (the old plan)
crosswalk.current_plan_id = plans.standard_component_id AND crosswalk.plan_year = plans.plan_year (the new plan)

tables.name: rates
tables.description: Monthly premium for each plan, rating area, age band and tobacco status. The main table.
tables.grain: One row per plan_year x plan_id x rating_area_id x age x tobacco. Join to plans for metal level, issuer, deductible.

columns.name: plan_year
columns.description: Plan year (2025, 2026 or 2027). Every table has it. Always filter on it.

columns.name: state_code
columns.description: Two-character state abbreviation indicating the state where the plan is offered.

columns.name: issuer_id
columns.description: Five-digit numeric code that identifies the issuer organization in the Health Insurance Oversight System (HIOS).

columns.name: plan_id
columns.description: 14-character HIOS plan ID. Joins to plans.standard_component_id (plus plan_year).

columns.name: rating_area_id
columns.description: Rating area within the state, like 'Rating Area 3'. Numbers restart in every state. Premiums vary by rating area, not county.

columns.name: rating_area_num
columns.description: The number in rating_area_id, as an integer.

columns.name: tobacco
columns.description: 'No Preference' means one rate for everyone. 'Tobacco User/Non-Tobacco User' means the plan has separate smoker and non-smoker rates. NULL for family-tier rows.

columns.name: age
columns.description: Age band exactly as CMS reports it: '0-14', '15' ... '63', '64 and over', or 'Family Option'. To match a person's age use age_min and age_max instead.

columns.name: age_min
columns.description: Lowest age in the band. '0-14' is 0, '64 and over' is 64. NULL for 'Family Option'.

columns.name: age_max
columns.description: Highest age in the band. '0-14' is 14, '64 and over' is 120. NULL for 'Family Option'. Match an age with age_min <= X AND X <= age_max.

columns.name: individual_rate
columns.description: Monthly premium in dollars for one person, before subsidies. NULL when the plan has no price for that row (CMS placeholders 0 and 9999 were removed). It is the non-tobacco rate when the plan prices tobacco separately, and the rate for everyone when tobacco is 'No Preference'.

columns.name: individual_tobacco_rate
columns.description: Monthly premium in dollars for a tobacco user. Only filled when tobacco = 'Tobacco User/Non-Tobacco User', otherwise NULL.

columns.name: couple
columns.description: Insurance rate applied to a primary subscriber and secondary subscriber in a rating area for a family-tier rated plan when age equals Family Option.

columns.name: primary_subscriber_and_one_dependent
columns.description: Insurance rate applied to a primary subscriber and one dependent in a rating area for a family-tier rated plan when age equals Family Option.

columns.name: primary_subscriber_and_two_dependents
columns.description: Insurance rate applied to a primary subscriber and two dependents in a rating area for a family-tier rated plan when age equals Family Option.

columns.name: primary_subscriber_and_three_or_more_dependents
columns.description: Insurance rate applied to a primary subscriber and three or more dependents in a rating area for a family-tier rated plan when age equals Family Option.

columns.name: couple_and_one_dependent
columns.description: Insurance rate applied to a primary subscriber, secondary subscriber, and one dependent in a rating area for a family-tier rated plan when age equals Family Option.

columns.name: couple_and_two_dependents
columns.description: Insurance rate applied to a primary subscriber, secondary subscriber, and two dependents in a rating area for a family-tier rated plan when age equals Family Option.

columns.name: couple_and_three_or_more_dependents
columns.description: Insurance rate applied to a primary subscriber, secondary subscriber, and three or more dependents in a rating area for a family-tier rated plan when age equals Family Option.

columns.name: rate_effective_date
columns.description: Date that the insurance plan rate is effective.

columns.name: rate_expiration_date
columns.description: Date that the insurance plan rate expires.

tables.name: plans
tables.description: One row per plan: issuer, metal level, plan type, deductible, out-of-pocket max. Standard (non cost-sharing-reduction) variant only.
tables.grain: One row per plan_year x standard_component_id.

columns.name: plan_year
columns.description: Plan year (2025, 2026 or 2027). Every table has it. Always filter on it.

columns.name: state_code
columns.description: Two-character state abbreviation indicating the state where the plan is offered.

columns.name: issuer_id
columns.description: Five-digit numeric code that identifies the issuer organization in the Health Insurance Oversight System (HIOS).

columns.name: issuer_name
columns.description: Name of the insurance issuer organization.

columns.name: market_coverage
columns.description: 'Individual' (the ACA marketplace) or 'SHOP (Small Group)' (small employers).

columns.name: dental_only_plan
columns.description: 'Yes' for stand-alone dental plans, 'No' for medical plans. Filter to 'No' for health insurance questions.

columns.name: standard_component_id
columns.description: 14-character HIOS plan ID. Joins to rates.plan_id and crosswalk prior/current plan ids (plus plan_year).

columns.name: plan_name
columns.description: Marketing name of insurance plan.

columns.name: product_id
columns.description: Seven-character alpha-numeric code that identifies an insurance product within HIOS.

columns.name: network_id
columns.description: Identifier for a health care provider network.

columns.name: service_area_id
columns.description: Joins to service_area_counties (with issuer_id and plan_year) to find the counties the plan covers.

columns.name: is_new_plan
columns.description: Categorical indicator of whether the insurance plan is new for the current year or existed previously in the Marketplace.

columns.name: plan_type
columns.description: Type of insurance plan, such as HMO, PPO, or EPO.

columns.name: metal_level
columns.description: Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum or Catastrophic for medical plans. 'High' and 'Low' are dental plans only.

columns.name: exchange_type
columns.description: 'On Exchange', 'Off Exchange' or 'Both'.

columns.name: child_only_offering
columns.description: The types of adult and child enrollment options allowed by the insurance plan.

columns.name: is_hsa_eligible
columns.description: An indication of whether the insurance plan qualifies as a Health Savings Account (HSA) eligible plan.

columns.name: deductible_individual
columns.description: Individual in-network (tier 1) deductible in dollars for the standard plan variant. Medical deductible, or the combined medical and drug deductible when the plan combines them. NULL when not applicable.

columns.name: moop_individual
columns.description: Individual in-network (tier 1) maximum out-of-pocket in dollars for the standard plan variant, same medical or combined basis as deductible_individual. NULL when not applicable.

tables.name: service_area_counties
tables.description: Which counties each issuer service area covers. Statewide service areas are expanded to every county in the state.
tables.grain: One row per plan_year x issuer_id x service_area_id x county_fips.

columns.name: plan_year
columns.description: Plan year (2025, 2026 or 2027). Every table has it. Always filter on it.

columns.name: state_code
columns.description: Two-character state abbreviation indicating the state where the plan is offered.

columns.name: issuer_id
columns.description: Five-digit numeric code that identifies the issuer organization in the Health Insurance Oversight System (HIOS).

columns.name: service_area_id
columns.description: Identifier for a service area.

columns.name: service_area_name
columns.description: Name of a service area.

columns.name: county_fips
columns.description: Five-digit county FIPS code, like '48201' for Harris County, TX.

columns.name: county_name
columns.description: County name from the Census Bureau FIPS list, like 'Harris County'. Can be NULL if the FIPS code is not in that list.

columns.name: covers_entire_state
columns.description: 'Yes' when the issuer lists the whole state (counties were expanded by the build), 'No' when it listed counties.

columns.name: partial_county
columns.description: 'Yes' when only some zip codes of the county are covered. NULL for statewide service areas.

columns.name: market_coverage
columns.description: Categorical indicator of market coverage of plans submitted with this template.

columns.name: dental_only_plan
columns.description: Categorical indicator of dental-only status of plans submitted with this template.

tables.name: crosswalk
tables.description: Where enrollees in last year's plans were moved this year. Use it for year-over-year plan changes, discontinued plans and replacements.
tables.grain: One row per prior plan x county (x zip code for partial counties). plan_year is the year enrollees move INTO, so plan_year 2027 maps 2026 plans to 2027 plans.

columns.name: plan_year
columns.description: The year enrollees move into. plan_year 2027 means a 2026 plan crosswalked to a 2027 plan.

columns.name: state_code
columns.description: Two-character state abbreviation indicating the state where the plan is offered.

columns.name: dental_plan
columns.description: 'Y' for stand-alone dental plans, 'N' for medical plans.

columns.name: prior_plan_id
columns.description: 14-character plan ID in plan_year - 1. Joins to plans.standard_component_id with plan_year - 1.

columns.name: prior_issuer_id
columns.description: Identifier of the issuer for the prior year plan.

columns.name: prior_metal_level
columns.description: Metal level or tier of the prior year plan.

columns.name: current_plan_id
columns.description: 14-character plan ID in plan_year. NULL when the plan was discontinued with no replacement.

columns.name: current_issuer_id
columns.description: NULL when there is no replacement.

columns.name: current_metal_level
columns.description: NULL when there is no replacement.

columns.name: county_fips
columns.description: Five-digit county FIPS code the crosswalk applies to.

columns.name: zip_code
columns.description: '00000' means the whole county.

columns.name: crosswalk_level
columns.description: 0 same plan ID, 1 plan ID level, 2 plan ID and county level, 3 zip-code level.

columns.name: reason_code
columns.description: CMS reason code, 0 to 10. See crosswalk_outcome for a readable version.

columns.name: crosswalk_outcome
enum_values: Moved to a different issuer (set by CMS)
Moved to a different plan in the same product
columns.description: Readable outcome from reason_code. Count plans with COUNT(DISTINCT prior_plan_id) because one plan has many county rows.

tables.name: benefits
tables.description: Which benefits each plan covers and what the member pays in network (copay or coinsurance), for the standard plan variant.
tables.grain: One row per plan_year x standard_component_id x benefit_name. Join to plans on standard_component_id and plan_year.

columns.name: plan_year
columns.description: Plan year (2025, 2026 or 2027). Every table has it. Always filter on it.

columns.name: state_code
columns.description: Two-letter state abbreviation.

columns.name: issuer_id
columns.description: Five-digit HIOS issuer ID.

columns.name: standard_component_id
columns.description: 14-character HIOS plan ID. Joins to plans.standard_component_id (plus plan_year).

columns.name: benefit_name
columns.description: The benefit exactly as filed, like 'Primary Care Visit to Treat an Injury or Illness', 'Specialist Visit' or 'Preferred Brand Drugs'. There are too many names to list: call find_values to get the exact spelling.

columns.name: is_covered
columns.description: 'Covered' or 'Not Covered'. The cost sharing columns are NULL when the benefit is not covered.

columns.name: is_ehb
columns.description: 'Yes' when the benefit is an essential health benefit.

columns.name: copay_in_network
columns.description: Fixed in-network (tier 1) copay in dollars. 0 for 'No Charge'. NULL when the benefit uses coinsurance instead, or is not covered.

columns.name: copay_in_network_text
columns.description: The in-network copay exactly as filed, like '$50.00 Copay after deductible' or 'No Charge'. NULL when not applicable.

columns.name: copay_unit
columns.description: What the copay is charged per: 'Day' or 'Stay' for hospital-type benefits, otherwise 'Service' (a visit or an item). Only compare copays that share a unit. A per-Day copay is charged for every day. NULL when there is no copay.

columns.name: coinsurance_in_network
columns.description: In-network (tier 1) coinsurance: the percent of the cost the member pays, so 50 means 50%. 0 means no charge. NULL when the benefit uses a copay instead, or is not covered.

columns.name: coinsurance_in_network_text
columns.description: The in-network coinsurance exactly as filed, like '50.00% Coinsurance after deductible'. NULL when not applicable.

columns.name: after_deductible
columns.description: 'Yes' when the in-network cost sharing applies only after the deductible is met, 'No' when it applies from the first visit. NULL when the benefit has no cost sharing.

columns.name: quantity_limit
columns.description: 'Yes' when the plan limits how much of the benefit it covers.

columns.name: limit_qty
columns.description: Size of the limit, like 35 for 35 visits.

columns.name: limit_unit
columns.description: What limit_qty counts, like 'Visit(s) per Benefit Period' or 'Days per Benefit Period'.
